decisions.reason: The charting bundle is a low-cost add-on to the map.apps ecosystem that still adds value, though it has not been visible on the website since 2019, so a quiet withdrawal is possible.
The GIS platform is the firm's flagship and strategic direction, so it will continue to be developed and offered.
Mobile field data capture remains a core need for utility and public-sector customers, which justifies keeping it despite the lack of recent website visibility.
The search extension is tightly integrated with the web map apps offer and is cheap to maintain, although its sibling search plugin was already dropped.
